events.title: Meet an Author: Stacey McEwan
events.description: An intimate author talk featuring Stacey McEwan, providing insights into her writing process and literary themes followed by a Q&A session. This event is perfect for local book lovers and aspiring writers to connect and discuss literature.

events.title: Crystals and Botanical Candle Decorating Class
events.description: A hands-on workshop focused on the craft of candle making, incorporating crystals and botanicals for aesthetic design. It offers a relaxed environment to learn a new skill while interacting with other creative locals.
